description: List owned world, model, asset pack, material, material pack, Image, and video/audio assets with normalized summary fields. Pass project_id to filter to one active Project; omit it for account-wide All Assets, including projectless API assets labeled source=api. Pass asset_type to browse one category without querying the others. The optional limit is an integer from 1 through 50. Generated assets may include previewImageUrl for inline preview rendering, but final/provider/download asset URLs are intentionally omitted. Use get_asset_artifact_manifest for code-project imports, or list_asset_artifacts and get_asset_artifact for one selected downloadable output.

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return, from 1 through 50.

name: list_my_assets
title: List My Assets
